run a command on a host

Usage:
  ops run [flags] <host> [--] <command...>

Arguments:
  <host>          where to run it [edge|core]
                    edge    the edge pool
                    core
  <command...>    the command and its arguments (passed through as typed)

Flags:
  -f, --format string    how to print results (default text) [text|json|yaml]
                           text    aligned columns
                           json
                           yaml    human-friendly

Global Flags:
  -h, --help            print help
  -v, --verbose         say more (repeatable)
      --color string    when to color (default auto) [auto|always|never]
